environment: macOS, Node.js 22.22.2, local Chromium through Playwright, loopback HTTP server and isolated temporary Project homes
scope: Project tracking read models, governance ledger, secure local API, live invalidations, EN/FR React experience, official Arka Labs identity, human document reader, accessibility, responsive behavior, distribution and regressions across Complete, Essential and FastDev.
prerequisites: The development report development-report-norn-project-web-001 is schema-valid and selected by the Complete Pipeline.
The production Web bundle has been rebuilt after the final accessibility correction.
The release checks execute with loopback access for the local registry and Playwright server.

test_cases.name: Canonical Project tracking projections and governance
steps: Run the complete TypeScript unit and integration suites.
Exercise Project aggregation, human document projection, profile snapshots and append-only governance reduction.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Read models are deterministic, degraded state wins, documents stay immutable and governance history remains attributable.
test_cases.actual_result: All corresponding tests passed in the 57-check selftest and instrumented coverage run.

test_cases.name: Loopback API security boundary
steps: Start the Web runtime on a temporary loopback port.
Call the API without a token and with a foreign Origin.
Probe an orchestration mutation route and inspect the CSP.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Unauthorized requests fail, foreign origins fail, mutation is unavailable and static responses enforce a self-only CSP.
test_cases.actual_result: Playwright security test passed: responses were 401, 401 and 404 respectively, with default-src 'self' in CSP.

test_cases.name: Project manager EN/FR workflow
steps: Create the mandatory human profile.
Create a Project and an Essential Feature.
Switch the interface from English to French.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The Project and Feature are persisted, Essential is selected and the interface changes locale immediately.
test_cases.actual_result: Playwright completed the workflow and verified html lang=fr and French navigation.

test_cases.name: Official Arka Labs visual identity
steps: Load the production Web shell.
Inspect the official mark, primary red token, default theme and body typography.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The real Arka mark loads locally, #c70f43 is canonical, dark is default and Poppins is active.
test_cases.actual_result: All four assertions passed in Playwright; no substitute N monogram or remote visual dependency remains.

test_cases.name: Human editorial document rendering
steps: Project a signed v5 document through the shared backend model.
Render it in French with the shared React reader.
Inspect title, facts, numbered sections, structured records, references and technical disclosure.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The document reads as an editorial production inspired by Arka Deck patterns while preserving every contract field and optional raw JSON.
test_cases.actual_result: Backend and Vitest renderer tests passed; raw contract keys are replaced by localized labels and no HTML is accepted from Markdown.

test_cases.name: Responsive layout and accessibility
steps: Render the Feature view at 1024, 1440 and 1920 pixels.
Measure document root horizontal overflow.
Run axe-core against the final French view.
test_cases.expected_outcome: No incoherent overlap or horizontal overflow occurs and no serious or critical accessibility violation is reported.
test_cases.actual_result: All widths stayed within one pixel tolerance and Axe returned an empty serious/critical violation set.

test_cases.name: Localization and source quality gates
steps: Run typecheck, ESLint, max-lines and language gates.
Run Web catalog parity and document renderer tests.
test_cases.expected_outcome: EN and FR contracts remain type-compatible, public source stays canonical English and maintained files stay below 700 lines.
test_cases.actual_result: All gates passed; maximum allowed source length remains 700 lines and Web Vitest reports 3 passing tests.

test_cases.name: Regression across workflows and CLI/TUI
steps: Run npm run release:verify.
Complete selftest and the 60 E2E scenarios under coverage instrumentation.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Complete, Essential, FastDev, migrations, Agents, orchestration, audit, CLI and TUI retain existing behavior.
test_cases.actual_result: Release verification passed; selftest reported 57/57 checks and the E2E suite passed all 60 scenarios.

test_cases.name: Coverage, performance and dependency health
steps: Run source and CLI coverage thresholds.
Run the deterministic benchmark and dependency audit.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Coverage exceeds configured thresholds, benchmark stays within budgets and dependency audit is acceptable.
test_cases.actual_result: Coverage reached 75.8% lines, 71.09% functions and 65.53% branches; benchmark completed in 160.17 ms against a 5000 ms total budget; release verification exited successfully.

test_cases.name: Production package contents
steps: Install the packed artifact in a consumer without worktree node_modules.
Run npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts and inspect packaged paths.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The CLI runs from the consumer, dist/web and local brand assets ship, and .input, src and tests are excluded.
test_cases.actual_result: The consumer test passed; arka-norn-2.1.0.tgz is 1.8 MB compressed, 6.9 MB unpacked, contains 643 files and includes the Web bundle, logo and local fonts.
